description: Harness substrate read contract v1 — 6 operations for reading agent state registers and decision ledgers. First-party only (no third-party providers at v1). Skills declaring this MUST also declare `required_permissions: [harnessStateRead]`.

operations.description: Read full body + frontmatter of a named state register
operations.name: read_register

operations.description: Read one named section (## heading) from a register
operations.name: read_register_section

operations.description: Search across ledger files by query string with arch/ops scope filter
operations.name: grep_ledger

operations.description: Read one weekly ledger file by ISO week
operations.name: read_ledger_week

operations.description: Enumerate known weekly ledger files and month indices
operations.name: list_ledger_weeks

title: harness-state-v1
